job.title: SAP Software Developer & Cloud Lifecycle Management (m/w/d)

tailoring.headline: SAP Software Developer & Cloud Lifecycle Management – SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Expert
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over 5 years delivering enterprise e-commerce solutions on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, REST/OCC APIs and microservices, with proven experience designing PIM-ERP-MDM integrations, CI/CD pipelines, Docker/Kubernetes cloud deployments and production support. Skilled in techno-functional analysis, user story creation and stakeholder collaboration within agile teams. Certified SAP Commerce Cloud Developer, fluent in English, based in Karlsruhe.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Software Developer & Cloud Lifecycle Management
cover_en.hook: I am excited by your focus on delivering innovative SAP Commerce Cloud solutions within agile teams. With over five years of hands-on experience building and scaling SAP Commerce (Hybris) platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I can immediately contribute to your cloud lifecycle initiatives.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Expertise
bullets.text: Designed and delivered end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) features, including product catalog, pricing and order management, ensuring platform stability and performance.

bullets.label: API & Integration
bullets.text: Implemented OCC REST services and built PIM-ERP-MDM data pipelines (Profisee, DataHub, Hotfolders) that synchronized product data across global channels.

bullets.label: Cloud & DevOps
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, containerized services with Docker and orchestrated them on Kubernetes, supporting rapid releases and cloud scalability.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Leadership
bullets.text: Collaborated with international business stakeholders to analyse requirements, write user stories and functional specs, and provide production support and mentorship to junior developers.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, valid German work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, available from 16 December 2026, open to remote, hybrid or on-site work.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als SAP Software Developer & Cloud Lifecycle Management
cover_de.hook: Die Kombination aus agilen Teams und innovativen SAP Commerce Cloud-Lösungen begeistert mich. Mit über fünf Jahren Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Skalierung von SAP Commerce (Hybris) bei Rockwell Automation und Shell kann ich Ihr Cloud-Lifecycle-Management sofort unterstützen.

bullets.label: SAP-Commerce-Expertise
bullets.text: Entwarf und implementierte End-to-End-Funktionen auf SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) inkl. Produktkatalog, Preis- und Auftragsmanagement für stabile Plattformen.

bullets.label: API- und Integration
bullets.text: Erstellte OCC-REST-Services und PIM-ERP-MDM-Datenpipelines (Profisee, DataHub, Hotfolders) zur Synchronisation globaler Produktdaten.

bullets.label: Cloud- und DevOps
bullets.text: Führte CI/CD-Deployments auf CCv2 durch, containerisierte Services mit Docker und orchestrierte sie in Kubernetes für schnelle Releases.

bullets.label: Techno-funktionale Führung
bullets.text: Arbeitete mit internationalen Fachbereichen zusammen, analysierte Anforderungen, schrieb User Stories und funktionale Spezifikationen sowie Produktionssupport und Mentoring.

cover_de.logistics: Karlsruhe, gültige Arbeitserlaubnis, letzter Arbeitstag 15.12.2026, Verfügbarkeit ab 16.12.2026, flexibel remote, hybrid oder vor Ort.

tailoring.why_company: I am drawn to your commitment to composable commerce and the continuous delivery of SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for diverse clients. Your emphasis on agile, cloud-native development aligns perfectly with my experience in CI/CD, Kubernetes and end-to-end SAP Commerce integrations, allowing me to accelerate value creation from day one.
tailoring.motivation_short: Passionate about composable SAP Commerce Cloud solutions, I bring proven Java/Spring expertise, API integration and cloud-native delivery to drive your agile projects forward.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years delivering Java-based e-commerce platforms at Rockwell and Shell. I’m eager to help your team accelerate cloud lifecycle management. Open to discuss?
tailoring.offer: In the first months I will modernize your CI/CD pipelines on CCv2, enhance OCC/Spartacus integrations and streamline PIM-ERP data flows, leveraging my proven SAP Commerce Cloud expertise. My hands-on experience with production support ensures seamless platform stability during transition phases.
tailoring.insight: Your posting highlights a focus on composable commerce solutions within SAP Commerce Cloud. My background in building modular OCC APIs and integrating PIM/ERP systems positions me to accelerate your composable architecture implementation.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: SAP Software Developer & Cloud Lifecycle Management
tailoring.email_body: Ich bin Kranti Chavan, Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Entwickler mit über fünf Jahren Erfahrung bei Rockwell Automation und Shell. Ihr Fokus auf agile, composable Commerce-Lösungen spricht mich besonders an. Ich bringe fundierte Java/Spring-Kenntnisse, API-Integration und CI/CD-Erfahrung mit, um Ihre Cloud-Lifecycle-Prozesse zu optimieren. Gerne bespreche ich, wie ich Ihr Team unterstützen kann. Lebenslauf und Anschreiben liegen bei.
